source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of integration testing (PDF 27).

blocks.text: Unit testing ke baad Integration Testing ki jati hai ta ke mukhtalif components ya modules ke darmiyan len den (interaction) jaancha jaye. Unit testing akele units par tawajjo deti hai, jab ke integration testing yaqeeni banati hai ke yeh units milane ke baad saath theek kaam karein. Is testing mein interface ki ghaltiyan (do hisson ke jor ki ghaltiyan), modules ke darmiyan data ka bahao aur jorne se mutalliq doosre masle check kiye jate hain. Is se woh masle pakre jate hain jo unit testing mein samne nahi aate, jaise modules ke aapas ke rabte ya data sambhalne mein be-mel (mismatch).

blocks.prompt: Do units jo apne unit tests pass kar leti hain, milane par phir bhi fail kyun ho sakti hain?
blocks.explanation: Har unit akeli theek chal sakti hai lekin jorne ke tareeqe mein farq ho sakta hai, maslan ek unit data aise format mein bheje jo doosri ko samajh na aaye. Integration testing aise interface aur data flow ke masle pakarti hai.

items: Integration testing: unit testing ke baad; units ko mila kar test karna; interface errors aur data flow check karna.
